# CLI Command Tree

`starforge --help` lists **12 noun commands**; every verb lives underneath one of
them. This file is the migration guide from the pre-ADR-0007 flat surface (86
top-level commands) to the noun-verb tree, and the reference for where a moved
command lives now.

* Design and rationale: [`docs/adr/0007-noun-verb-command-tree.md`](adr/0007-noun-verb-command-tree.md)
* Full flag reference: [`docs/COMMAND_REFERENCE.md`](COMMAND_REFERENCE.md)
* Short command list: [`docs/COMMAND_CHEATSHEET.md`](COMMAND_CHEATSHEET.md) (generated by `build.rs`)

## Top-level commands

| Noun | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `wallet` | Wallets, keys, transactions, SEP-10 auth, multisig, devices |
| `contract` | Invoke, build, inspect, test, audit, security, upgrade, monitor |
| `deploy` | `deploy run` and the deployment lifecycle (history, env, schedule, cost) |
| `network` | Active network, local node, simulation, snapshots |
| `template` | Templates, template VCS, the remote registry |
| `plugin` | Third-party plugins |
| `ai` | Local assistant, AI audits/tests/search/planning, prompts, help |
| `config` | Config files, `config info`, telemetry, feature flags, privacy |
| `project` | Project scaffolding, tasks, sprints, collaboration |
| `tool` | Tutorials, natural language, PR checks, bug reports |
| `completions` | Shell completion scripts |
| `man` | Man pages |

`autocomplete` and plugin-provided external commands are still registered but
hidden from `--help`.

## Migration table

Every command below keeps working for one minor release. The old spelling
prints a deprecation warning on **stderr** naming its replacement:

```console
$ starforge test --wasm hello.wasm
warning: `starforge test` is deprecated and will stop working in starforge 0.2.0; use `starforge contract test` instead
```

### Legacy `starforge ai <verb>` invocations

`ai` keeps its name, so the old flat verbs needed a second rewrite: they now
live under `ai local`. `starforge ai pull llama3` becomes
`starforge ai local pull llama3`, with the same warning.

| Old command | Use instead | Removed in |
|---|---|---|
| `starforge ai status` | `starforge ai local status` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai models` | `starforge ai local models` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai pull` | `starforge ai local pull` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai ask` | `starforge ai local ask` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai audit` | `starforge ai local audit` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai explain` | `starforge ai local explain` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai test` | `starforge ai local test` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai optimise` | `starforge ai local optimise` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai profile` | `starforge ai local profile` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai compare-profiles` | `starforge ai local compare-profiles` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai patterns` | `starforge ai local patterns` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai library` | `starforge ai local library` | 0.2.0 |
| `starforge ai pattern-feedback` | `starforge ai local pattern-feedback` | 0.2.0 |

## Regenerating

The two tables above are rendered from the `DEPRECATED_COMMANDS` table in
`src/commands/deprecations.rs`; that table is the single source of truth. If you
add a row there, update this file in the same commit.
